scope.root: Workspace orchestration only; not a published package in this inventory.

semantics.dependencies: Declared name/alias matches to current workspace manifests, not pnpm installed resolution. Version ranges are preserved, not assumed satisfied. Duplicate names retain every candidate path.
semantics.runtimeGraph: dependencies and optionalDependencies; peer and development edges are separate.
semantics.boundaries: Proposed migration responsibility, not a deprecation decision. think-logger requires duplicate-name review; think-demo is an example.
semantics.externalReferences: First-party-looking dependency names absent from this workspace are recorded but never synthesized as packages.
semantics.missingManifestFields: null means absent; no implicit Node/npm defaults are invented.
semantics.baseline: Fixed planning baseline; manifests reflect current checkout. Generation does not depend on wall-clock time, installed modules or git HEAD.

batches.responsibility: Private Service registry generator prototype; complete development integration in P2
Foundations: pure utilities, storage primitives and process helpers
Request pipeline: configuration, routing, parsing, dispatch, validation and errors
Bootstrap: migrate application and loader together after resolving their runtime cycle
State: cache/session contracts and file, cookie, JWT, Redis and Memcache adapters
Data: model contracts, SQL drivers and adapters, MongoDB and ORM integrations
Presentation/transport: views, WebSockets, localization and pagination
Integrations: GraphQL, HTTP/email clients, middleware and security helpers
Tooling: CLI, transpilers, watching, inspection and test mocking; template submodule separately
Legacy boundary: decide ownership of duplicate logger before any migration or publication
Example boundary: validate application consumption; no library publishing assumption
New packages require explicit migration responsibility review.
